name: Rocketdoo CI

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint addons
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install Rocketdoo and ruff
        run: pip install "rocketdoo~=3.5" ruff

      - name: Ruff check
        run: ruff check --output-format=github --target-version py312 addons/

      - name: Validate module manifests
        run: rkd deploy validate -p addons
